d:
Kalamkari is a dying traditional art form of hand painting on clothes which has a history of 3000 years. This art form involves all the five elements of nature in the process of making. One Kalamkari cloth takes up to 45 days of hard work. After all the hardwork which goes into the cloth, these artists find no encouragement for their art form. This particular documentary focuses on the practice of art, importance of art and the state of art. This art speaks for itself.
